text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year! New Year's here is<n>awful
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I know just what to do at a<n>shrine! Ya toss a
coin into the<n>collection box and then give a big<n>round
of applause!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? I just figured the gods<n>would enjoy it
more if I set the mood.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aaanyway, how 'bout we mosey on<n>over to a
shrine?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I end up paying a visit to a shrine with<n>Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I asked the gods to sit back and<n>watch me become
Umamusume of<n>the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I put in plenty of work last year, so<n>now we just
gotta wait for the<n>announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they'll be all smiles when<n>I'm picked for
the title! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What did ya pray for, Trainer? Hopin'<n>to become
prime minister of Japan?
choice_data_list: I prayed for you to stay healthy.
I prayed for you to keep growing and flourishing.
I prayed for your running to improve.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?! You prayed for me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Did ya know about me pullin'<n>an all-nighter
last night?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll nix the night owl act so I<n>can stay
healthy and strong!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, we wrap up our shrine visit.<n>It won't be
long now until the<n>Umamusume of the Year
announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks! I'm sure I'll shoot up<n>just like a
beanstalk!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep growin' and growin'<n>so I can
catch hold of my dream with<n>both hands!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel power wellin' up inside me all<n>of a sudden!
Let's get training,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, we wrap up our shrine visit.<n>It won't be
long now until the<n>Umamusume of the Year
announcement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Improve? You mean, like, learn some<n>new tricks?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! I think we're on the same page!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not very good at breakin'<n>outta the gate, so
make sure to<n>include that in your prayer!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, we wrap up our shrine visit.<n>It won't be
long now until the<n>Umamusume of the Year
announcement!
